artifacts.summary: 13-phase plan for the L-plus compression theorem: transcribes the Formula-side compression pipeline to L-plus, then builds the representative structure, splice-closed lift, (C0) and (C5) with no precedent; ends with the theorem-index row and C2 axiom pin.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic's sharing-witness-family substrate, choosing a hop-free succession relation (trans := transIdOf, so trans u i j iff i = j) collapses the two branching certificate conditions to their non-branching per-lasso forms: (C1') PlusLocalCoherentShare reduces to PlusLocalCoherentLab because the untl/snce clauses' quantified index is forced equal to the source index, and (C2') PlusThreadFulfilling reduces to PlusFulfillingLab because Thread.step plus identity-trans forces every thread's index function to be constant. This leaves only (C0) atom coherence and (C5) stability faithfulness as genuinely sharing-side obligations, and it discharges the lift field through liftable_of_spliceClosed with a constant lifting path whose only succession demand is reflexivity. The competing choice, trans := transFullOf, discharges lift in one term but reverts (C1') to the pre-redesign reading that makes the certificate class empty for stability-modal targets, so it is a closed option rather than a cheaper alternative. When planning any new producer of a SharingSkeleton-backed family, decide the trans shape first: it determines how many conditions remain to prove.
